rows.en: With it, you should be able to break through the Ride Dungeon's walls.
Hikari...!! That's awesome!!!
A drill that bursts right through walls...! That gives me chills!
Yes. Though there's no guarantee there's a Cube beyond them.
No, we'll find a way through, no doubt about it! Our goal is the Hideout Cube!!
Black RX joined the party!
Obtained Cherudim Gundam's chip.
Obtained Arios Gundam's chip.
Obtained Seravee Gundam's chip.
Obtained Deathscythe Hell's chip.
Obtained Heavyarms's chip.
Obtained Gundam Sandrock's chip.
Upon arriving at the base, Zoffy was welcomed as commander.
His seasoned, well-informed battle judgment will surely be a great help to the heroes.
Zoffy told them everything he knew.
Yes... In other words, a fourth Cube exists.
But to get there, we have to destroy the "wall"...
Exactly.
Seravee, what wall?
Yes. There was a wall in the "Ride Dungeon" that we simply couldn't break.
You couldn't break it at all...? ...Then we need a more powerful drill.
Hey, speaking of drills... We've got that one we picked up earlier, right?
What is it?
Ankh and the others handed over the "Broken Permidar Drill" they had found at the quarry.
Oh... A drill, huh.
If I can repair it properly, we should be able to equip it on the Ride Machine.
Give me a little time.
As for us, we'll deal with the enemy in front of us first.
Yapool and Ikadevil, huh...
This is unconfirmed, but it seems Ikadevil has already moved to another Cube.
To the fourth Cube?
That, I don't know.
Well, that's good news, ain't it! For now, we only gotta focus on Yapool!
Hmm... But this is Yapool we're talking about. He must be hiding some trump card.
Be careful when you take him on.
Yes... In other words, a fourth Cube exists.
But to get there, we have to destroy the "wall"...
Exactly.
Seravee, what wall?
Yes. There was a wall in the Ride Dungeon that we simply couldn't break.
In that case, the drill that Ankh and the others brought back earlier might work.
That is, once I've finished repairing it...
How long will it take?
I'll be as quick as I can... I'll get started on it right away!
As for us, we'll deal with the enemy in front of us first.
Yapool and Ikadevil, huh...
This is unconfirmed, but it seems Ikadevil has already moved to another Cube.
To the fourth Cube?
That remains unknown.
Well, hey, that's good news, ain't it! For now, we only gotta focus on Yapool!
Hmm... But this is Yapool we're talking about. He must be hiding some trump card.
Be careful when you take him on.
So the showdown with Yapool is finally here!
Then we've got no time to rest either!
Ultraman, Seven, have you recovered?
Yes, I'm fine now.
I see! Then I want you two to join the fight as well.
Of course!
...I see. We can't go on unless we beat the Modified Bemstar and break through that room.
Still, it's a stroke of luck that we managed to rescue Kamen Rider 2, at least.
But why did Skull... No, why did the Dummy Dopant save only Rider 2...?
...save Rider 2...?
...I don't know either. Maybe it was scheming something.
For now, let's just focus on Rider 1 and the Ultra Warriors.
But to save Rider 1 and my brothers, we have to defeat the Modified Bemstar...!!
That mouth on its belly is the problem...
...Hmm.
Hikari... Isn't there anything? Something that could plug that mouth...
That's a tough one... There's nothing we can use.
If only we had some highly adhesive substance... Something like birdlime, for example...
Huh? Birdlime?
What is it, Ankh? Does that ring a bell?
Ankh grudgingly began telling them of the birdlime-like stuff he'd seen lying in the enemy lab.
...That's most likely a "Polymer Plaster Bomb." It must have misfired in an experiment.
There may still be some usable ones left. It's worth checking out.
Understood! Let's go back there one more time!
Yeah, let's!
Seriously...?
What's wrong, Ankh? Don't tell me you're scared?

notes.note: Speakers from 0912.bla (TextIdOffset -194): #0.36/#0.39 Hikari, #0.37/#0.40 Zero, #0.38 W (Philip). Rows were unlabelled. #0.36/#0.37 reuse story_043 (0256 #0.230/#0.231) English.
Philip's signature 'zokuzoku' rendered 'That gives me chills', matching story_053.
Zero answering Hikari's 'no guarantee'. 'We'll find a way through' for 'the road will surely open'.

Chip lines use the full machine names as written (Cherudim Gundam, Arios Gundam, Seravee Gundam, Gundam Sandrock); format 'Obtained X's chip.' as in earlier slices. The 7th chip line (#0.48) is in story_184.
0913 is a copy of 0358 (story_064) with the Zeroliner Drill swapped for the Permidar Drill (glossary). Identical lines reuse story_064 English; speakers verified against 0913.bla (offset 0).
Differs from 0358 #0.106 (no 'beyond this point'), so that phrase is dropped. #0.11 has 'wall' in quotes and #0.14 'Ride Dungeon' in quotes in the source; quotes kept.
Hikari asking what Ankh means; reused 0358 #0.113 'What is it?' (the TM suggestion 'What's that?' came from an unrelated table).
Narration; 'Broken Permidar Drill' capitalised and quoted like the earlier 'Broken Zeroliner Drill'.
0913.bla plays #0.27 or #0.53 depending on flag 2737, likewise #0.28/#0.54; #0.15-#0.21 vs #0.45-#0.48 are the same flag's two branches.

#0.40-#0.44, #0.49-#0.52, #0.55-#0.56 are never played by 0913.bla (unlabelled spares). Speakers inferred from their twins (#0.10-#0.14, #0.23-#0.26, #0.29-#0.30); English identical to the twins where the Japanese is identical.
Zoffy to Ultraman and Seven (just rescued); 'have you recovered?' for asking whether their bodies are all right. Their replies to Zoffy are polite.
Unused leftover fragment (script skips +3); reuses story_048 0314 #0.92 English, the second half of #0.3's question.
Narration silence while Ankh explains (no name window).

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0912/0913/0914.bla; 0912 #0.36-#0.40 were unlabelled (Hikari/Zero/Philip/Hikari/Zero). 0913 copies 0358 and 0914 varies 0314: identical lines reuse story_064/story_048 English. 0913 #0.40-#0.56 spares are partly unplayed (flag 2737 branches); speakers inferred from twins. No new names; Permidar Drill per glossary.
